public_health_question.v: What was the source of a cluster of Salmonella Livingstone infections in two neighboring Utah counties, and did open-ended interviews and purchase histories speed its identification?

ev.q: Health officials investigated to identify the source and prevent additional illnesses.

notes: Descriptive outbreak case series of 11 cases with no group comparison, so data_focus is limited.
